title: [P1] Optional HTTP MCP initialization can prevent the entire runtime from becoming ready
detail: New awaited headless mcp command waits for the whole initial connection promise. A peer returning initialize but not acknowledging notifications/initialized stalls it beyond configured request timeout. Baseline reaches ready; latest does not. This also affects assembly recreation during reload.
fix: Use cancellation-aware bounded readiness/failure handling without leaking owned resources or making an optional tool provider a permanent Harness startup prerequisite.

title: [P2] Launcher regression hashes a non-canonical workspace path and leaks an unexpected detached test runtime on macOS
detail: The test hashes /tmp while launch.ts hashes realpath (/private/tmp). Its wrong-cwd rejection case opens a different session and waits forever; the test originally cleans up only its first observed runtime. Local fixture-only correction preserves assertions and tracks all announced owned PIDs; proposed patch retained, not pushed into PR.
fix: Normalize expected workspace identity; keep alias reconnect coverage and failure-safe owned runtime teardown.
